verdict.rationale: Convex documents a first-party self-hosted backend that runs on your own servers, with the same code as the cloud service. It works with infrastructure such as Fly.io, RDS, Neon and Postgres, so users can control where data physically lives by choosing their own hosting. No evidence shows region or residency selection within the managed Convex cloud. Missing for 10: region/residency choice for cloud deployments, documented data-residency guarantees or region list, independent corroboration.
